training.source: first 13 concepts from composition-v1; structured initialization for 60 new detectors; learned random output head
training.constraints: on input weights > 0; off input weights < 0; any input weights = 0; local/skeleton output weights >= 0.05; defect output weights <= -0.05
training.loss: classification margins 1.6/0.4; concept MSE 0.2; exact logit margins +/-0.55 (local), +/-2.5 (structural); edge contribution margin 0.14

featureVerification.method: exact linear extrema for every satisfying/violating pattern, including all backgrounds
